headline: Star Housing Finance director ceases office
summary: Amlendra Prasad Saxena ceased to be an Independent Director of Star Housing Finance Ltd on October 23, 2026, after completing his tenure.

headline: BHEL appoints two senior management heads
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd appointed Rajeeva Srivastava and Amit Gupta as heads of International Operations and Defence & Aerospace Business Group respectively, effective October 25, 2026.
